pr_title: core/service: set up credentials for all start-post commands too
pr_comments: I'll introduce a helper like that. But I think ExecCondition= and -Reload= by design should not be accessing credentials.

issue_context.title: systemd credentials: $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY empty with given service, no error in logs
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

255

### Used distribution

NixOS 23.11

### Linux kernel version used

6.1.75

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

systemd

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

Post run script has access to a decrypted credential file at `$CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/<NAME>key`.

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

In the post run script, `$CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY` is set, but not created/mounted by systemd and devoid of files.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Created systemd service as pasted below
2. Encrypted credential e.g. with `systemd-creds --name=<NAME>key encrypt source.key /var/lib/secrets/<NAME>data/key.cred` 
3. Started service

TMP2 is not used on the system. I suspect some unfortunate interaction between `LoadCredentialEncrypted` and one of these:
```
[Service]
BindPaths=... BindPaths=... BindPaths=... CapabilityBoundingSet=... DevicePolicy=... PrivateDevices=... PrivateTmp=... StateDirectory=... StateDirectory=... StateDirectory=... StateDirectory=... WorkingDirectory=...
```
There should at least be a log message or warning as to what exactly is happening and documentation in `LoadCredential` / `LoadCredentialEncrypted` what other options they might conflict with or what timing issues may occur.

comments: @YHNdnzj thanks for your quick work in #31197 on a Sunday, nonetheless. Can you give me a timeline on when this will see an official release?

review_comments: Here, EXEC_WRITE_CREDENTIALS is set when the state is `SERVICE_CONDITION`. So, I think we should enable credentials for commands `SERVICE_EXEC_CONDITION`, no?

As mentioned in commit msg, I think this is accidentally introduced in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/27279. I don't think this is desirable, and the first `ExecCondition=` cannot access creds anyway. So the incompatibility introduced should be negligible.
OK, but the commit message mention ExecReload. Please also mention ExecCondition somewhere.
Oh, in the revised commit, it is mentioned. Thank you.
